paper_metadata.title: Spinodal decomposition induced nanoprecipitates strengthened CoCrNi-base medium entropy alloy

The alloy ingots of the non-equiatomic CoCrNi0.1Mo0.1 HEAs were prepared by arc melting a mixture of pure metals (purity > 99.9%) in a Ti-gettered high-purity Ar atmosphere, and repeated melted at least five times to ensure homogeneity.
subsequently homogenized in vacuum for 2 h at 1200 ◦C
cold-rolled to 2 mm (thickness reduction of 80%)
The cold rolled specimen was annealed at 1100 ◦C for 1 min in the air to get the re-crystallized structure (water quenching)
ageing at 600 ◦C for 24 h and 144 h with water quenching (denoted as Age24 and Age144, respectively)
ageing at 600 ◦C for 24 h and 144 h with water quenching (denoted as Age24 and Age144, respectively)
Apparently, the full-crystallization alloy only consisted of a single FCC phase structure.
the new phase is L12 structure
the nanoprecipitate is μ-phase structure. The nano-precipitate phase distributed on the grain boundaries with a size less than 200 nm.
there are high-density annealing twins in the equiaxed grains of the Age24 alloy
The homogenized alloy consists of very coarse grains of ~110 μm in size
the grain is refined to 2–3 μm after cold-rolling and recrystallized
The grain size of the alloy is still 2–3 μm after ageing 24 h.
the grains growth obviously to ~38 μm with the increase of ageing time to 144 h
significant amount of SFs in some grain, accompanying with high density dislocation
A large number of dislocations accumulated in the grain boundaries and the grain are slightly deformed by rotation
The yield strength (YS) and tensile strength (TS) of re-crystallized alloy are 609 MPa and 950 MPa.
The yield strength (YS) and tensile strength (TS) of re-crystallized alloy are 609 MPa and 950 MPa.
After ageing for 24 h at 600 ◦C, the alloy exhibits higher YS and TS of about 900 MPa and 1215 MPa.

both Age24 and Age144 alloys exhibit good ductility (40% and 45%)
As ageing time increases to 144 h, the YS and TS are 620 MPa and 1025 MPa.
As ageing time increases to 144 h, the YS and TS are 620 MPa and 1025 MPa.
both Age24 and Age144 alloys exhibit good ductility (40% and 45%)
The structure of two-phase coexistence is generated by spinodal decomposition, which is the same as previous studies
multiple strengthening mechanisms of the Age24 alloy include solid-solution strengthening (σS), grain refinement strengthening (σG) and precipitation strengthening (σP)

The HNPs can be sheared by dislocations to eliminate the stress concentrations and premature failure.
